decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer, the firm has invested in it and committed to it publicly, and it is central to its announced direction, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
The cleaning centrifuge supports the firm's stated sustainability and coolant-filtering focus, so any weak early results would be read as temporary ramp-up effects.
The multi-model nozzle line is a low-cost complement to the coolant systems and has visible commitment on the website, so management would trim models rather than drop the line.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's established conveying business and would be kept as a core part of its portfolio.
The magnetic belt conveyor builds on the firm's established chip conveyor range, serves metalworking customers directly, and the firm has invested in it, so it stays.
Hinged belt conveyors are a core standard product that is central to the firm's identity in material flow, so retiring it is very unlikely.
